Get a sample of rows from a dataset

Source: R/dataset.R
dc_sample.Rd

Useful for previewing what dc_get() will return without pulling the full time series.

Usage

dc_sample(client, dataset_id, n = 10L)

Arguments

client

A datacore_client created with datacore_client().

dataset_id

Character. The dataset id, e.g. "equity.vn30.daily".

n

Integer. Number of rows to return. Defaults to 10.

Value

A tibble with up to n rows.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  dc <- datacore_client()
  dc_sample(dc, "equity.vn30.daily", n = 5)
} # }
